name: Limitless Nexus
description: Nexus build/test repository for Limitless providers. AniKoto experiments are parked in Limitless-Provider-Lab. NetMirror and Vidlink remain active validation providers; KissKH has a hardened Eclipsia-backed control plus a new standalone Nexus implementation for independence/fallback validation. A temporary KissKH audit provider remains for comparison.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using the shared Nexus anime identity layer with MAL/Jikan, AniList, TMDB/IMDb-backed fallbacks, specials handling, and clean quality/audio labels.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus

scrapers.name: WCO
scrapers.description: WCO production provider with mirror coverage, strict title/episode ownership, anime identity support, specials handling, Power Rangers mapping, and clean quality/audio labels.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus WCO production merge

scrapers.name: AsiaFlix Test
scrapers.description: AsiaFlix v0.3.6 StreamWish canonical-player markup diagnostic based on verified-working Yuzono AniYomi AsiaFlix v32. Catalog and episode matching remain verified; the test inspects the working niramirus/medixiru player pages for scripts, iframes, forms, redirects, and player markers before reproducing the next upstream extractor step.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based directly on verified-working Yuzono AsiaFlix v32

scrapers.name: Tubi
scrapers.description: Tubi playback provider with current anonymous auth, nested episode mapping, anime identity support, Power Rangers franchise-title mapping, compact diagnostics, and quality-first labels.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus Tubi provider

scrapers.name: NetMirror
scrapers.description: Pinned All-in-One-Nuvio NetMirror adapter with upstream settings preserved and Nexus quality/audio labels normalized; service names are shown only when needed to distinguish equivalent rows.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus adapter; upstream NetMirror credit: Dustincos / All-in-One-Nuvio

scrapers.name: Vidlink
scrapers.description: Eclipsia v9.9.0 Haylox/Vidlink adapter with upstream extraction preserved and Nexus quality/audio/subtitle labels normalized for the stream dialog.
scrapers.author: Eclipsia; Nexus presentation adapter

scrapers.name: KissKH
scrapers.description: Working Eclipsia v9.9.0 Fyron/KissKH extraction wrapped with strict TMDB title/alias ownership validation and verified KissKH drama-ID matching, plus Nexus quality/audio/subtitle labels.
scrapers.author: Eclipsia; Nexus ownership and presentation adapter

scrapers.name: KissKH Standalone
scrapers.description: Nexus-owned KissKH implementation with no Eclipsia/Codeberg runtime dependency, strict TMDB title ownership, sequential KissKH domain failover, Video/Video_tmp direct media fallbacks, EncDec video/subtitle tokens, encrypted subtitle proxy-decryption, and adaptive HLS expansion when a master playlist exists.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus; flow cross-checked against maintained KissKH references

scrapers.name: KissKH Audit
scrapers.description: Temporary diagnostic wrapper around Eclipsia Fyron/KissKH. Traces token and episode query shape, playback headers, subtitle flow, source fields, ThirdParty fallback behavior, and HLS variants for Den-O/Ex-Aid comparison.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus diagnostic; upstream: Eclipsia Fyron
